title: MTP acceptance analysis: position effect, gating simulation, overhead accounting

inputs.trace: tools/mtp/report_mtp_258v.json (80 samples: 5 prompts x 16 steps, draft==trunk-greedy per round)
inputs.excluded: tools/mtp/report_accept.json is B60/Qwen3.8-27B-era (64-layer trunk) and does NOT apply to the 258V model

method.step: one trunk decode_step vs previous-step draft; acceptance = draft == trunk greedy
method.simulation: trace-driven policy simulation on the 80-sample trace; rollback cost swept 0/5/10 ms; NOT a device re-run

position_effect.note: every prompt improves late; rejects cluster at generation start (e.g. RRRR openings). MTP head is weak right after prefill, excellent once rolling.

findings.gating_verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED as primary optimization. Trace sim: warmup gates (K=2/4/6) and warmup+reject-disable all land within +/-2% of always-speculate across rollback 0-10 ms. Cause: draft is only 11% of trunk, so breakeven alpha ~= 0.28 and even the worst bin (steps 0-1, alpha 0.20) roughly breaks even. Gating forfeits accepted early tokens for no reliable gain.

integration_overhead.definition: end-to-end round time minus (draft + dual-verify medians); covers extra list submits, host loop, rollback restores
integration_overhead.magnitude: 5-9 ms/round, i.e. 20-30% tax on a 28 ms trunk step; fully explains projected-1.44x vs realized-1.198x gap
integration_overhead.caveat: mixes medians across two harnesses (bench_mtp vs bench_speculative); derived, not profiled

findings.regime_note: prompt-0 class exists (late alpha only 0.50). A trailing-alpha kill-switch (<0.3, B60 adaptive-controller pattern) is cheap insurance, not the prize.

recommendations: profile per-submit timestamps (draft submit / verify submit / rollback / host gap) to split the 5-9 ms before cutting it
attack round overhead (fused draft+verify submission, host off critical path) rather than acceptance gating
re-run acceptance at longer horizons (64+ steps) before trusting the late-alpha asymptote
limits: n=80 trace + 5 device prompts; late-alpha 0.82 rests on 50 samples
rollback cost not isolated on device
no KV8 content: 258V runtime is BF16-KV only; KV8xMTP needs an INT8-KV port (see T6.6 rationale)
